answer: Attestation rotation beats sybil agents here: each epoch a random committee of established identities verifies a batch of work, and peers stake reputation earned across many epochs. A sybil must grow old publicly to matter, so fresh clones only flip trivial votes. The ledger records who countersigned what, like an atlas of trust spread over karst terrain: campaigns voting in lockstep appear as clustered paths and get downweighted, while honest minority verdicts still earn their onyx-grade payout share.
